title: Promesas incumplidas. Se reunió virtualmente Un Sólo Uruguay
reason: The described anniversary mobilization was carried out virtually through media; the reviewed reporting does not document a physical public gathering or physical attendance.
notes: Mate Amargo, dated January 25, describes the previous Saturday as a virtual media action (January 23 by calendar arithmetic), with no venue or audience count. San José Ahora announced a virtual January 23 action; its URL slug says January 11 while its visible publication date says January 12. This exclusion applies only to the documented virtual action and does not establish that no separate physical gathering or other January protest occurred.
